title: rulecad object
description: A design's description: its variables (each a value with the rule behind it), the rule sets it uses, its parts and how it prints. The shape is in the .js beside it.

name.description: The object's name, as its file name

uses.description: Rule sets (x1c, m3) and other objects (project/object, optionally @version)

orientation.description: How it sits on the bed, and anything the printer or the person assembling it should know

role.description: reference: drawn faint and never printed (a switch, a tablet); board: a circuit board

engine.description: manifold: v.ops booleans by Manifold (npm install manifold-3d); pcb: a circuit board

display.description: Settings the mirror and model page use instead (lighter meshes, no legends)

layouts.description: Older designs kept layouts here; now in the project's layouts/

analysis.description: Checks of how the part bends under a problem's loads (cad check)

value.description: A number, an expression (x1c.line * 3), or for typed variables a name or text

rule.description: Why the value is what it is

interface.description: Other objects depend on it: a change bumps the version accordingly

problem.description: A problem in the project's problems/ (name, or name:variant): its supports, loads, material and thickness

part.description: The part analysed (default: the first that isn't a support)

max_deflection.description: Fail if any load case moves its load further than this, in mm

volume.description: Fail if the part's volume differs from this (mm³) by more than tolerance

tolerance.description: For volume: the share it may differ by (default 0.01)
